Column: The Group’s objectives when managing capital, which is a broader concept than the ‘equity’ on the face of the
 To comply with the capital requirements set by the regulator, Capital Markets Authority;
 To safeguard the Group’s ability (and its subsidiaries) to continue as a going concern so that it can
continue to provide returns for shareholders and benefits for other stakeholders.
 To maintain a strong capital base to support the development of its business; and
 To comply, at the operating companies level, with capital requirements set by respective regulators such
as the Central Bank of Kenya and Bank of South Sudan.
